findings.summary: The exception constant is a dict keyed by (package, candidate_sha, merged_sha) rather than a single named triple, so structurally it could hold additional entries; any addition would itself require a reviewed code change through the same governed path, so this is not a bypass mechanism. No change requested.
The tuple's package key is compared raw, not casefolded, against the literal - the strict direction: a differently-cased package can never match the exception. Confirmation that no widening exists.
